inventory_text:
A3. equipment | ui_label: Provision Equipment | type: select | required: no | constraints: none | auto_filled: yes
A4. service_type | ui_label: Service Type | type: select | required: yes | constraints: none | auto_filled: yes
A5. priority | ui_label: Priority | type: select | required: yes | constraints: none | auto_filled: yes
A6. subject | ui_label: Subject | type: text | required: yes | constraints: maxLength 175 | auto_filled: yes
A7. description | ui_label: Description | type: textarea | required: no | constraints: none | auto_filled: yes
A8. files | ui_label: Attachment | type: file | required: no | constraints: Allowed file types: Image, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, Eml, Easm, Mp4, Mov | auto_filled: no

B4. equipment -> service_type | EFFECT: filter | GUARD: none | REVERSAL: reset service_type

C1. FIELD: department | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C2. FIELD: staff_accountable | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C3. FIELD: staff_assigned | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C4. FIELD: due_date | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion

D1. customer CAN see the record | WHEN: they are the ticket owner or have visibility to the user
D2. agent CAN see the record | WHEN: they are assigned, accountable, or have department access

E3. FIELD: equipment | SOURCE: known_entities.customers[].equipment | DISPLAY LABEL: provision_name
E4. FIELD: service_type | SOURCE: known_entities.departments[].service_types | DISPLAY LABEL: name
E5. FIELD: priority | SOURCE: static | DISPLAY LABEL: label

# --- HEURISTIC INJECTED ROLE EXCLUSIONS ---
C5. FIELD: customer | CONDITION: Heuristic JSX Match | SHOWN TO: other | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C6. FIELD: user | CONDITION: Heuristic JSX Match | SHOWN TO: other | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion

scenarios.description: Create a ticket with all required fields filled with valid values for a customer.

inputs.subject: Server not responding
inputs.description: The main server at Acme HQ is not responding to any requests.

scenarios.assertion: Ticket is successfully created and visible in the customer's ticket list.

scenarios.description: Test subject field at max length of 175 characters.
scenarios.assertion: Form submits successfully with subject at max length.

scenarios.description: Test subject field with length exceeding max limit by one character.
scenarios.assertion: Error message displayed for subject exceeding max length.

scenarios.description: Test attachment field with allowed file type (PDF).
scenarios.assertion: Form submits successfully with allowed file type.

scenarios.description: Test attachment field with disallowed file type (exe).
scenarios.expected_message: File type not allowed. Please upload a valid file type.
scenarios.assertion: Error message displayed for disallowed file type.

scenarios.description: Attempt to upload an unsupported file type as an attachment.
scenarios.expected_message: Invalid file type. Allowed types are: Image, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, Eml, Easm, Mp4, Mov.

scenarios.description: Verify that selecting equipment filters the service type options.
scenarios.assertion: Service Type options are filtered based on selected equipment.

scenarios.description: Verify that selecting service type before equipment self-corrects after equipment is set.
scenarios.assertion: Service Type self-corrects based on selected equipment.

scenarios.description: Verify that clearing the equipment resets the service type options.
scenarios.assertion: Service Type options reset when equipment is cleared.

scenarios.description: Verify that the 'department' field is not visible to the customer.
scenarios.assertion: Department field is not present in the DOM

scenarios.description: Verify that the 'staff_accountable' field is not visible to the customer.
scenarios.assertion: Staff Accountable field is not present in the DOM

scenarios.description: Verify that the 'staff_assigned' field is not visible to the customer.
scenarios.assertion: Staff Assigned field is not present in the DOM

scenarios.description: Verify that the 'due_date' field is not visible to the customer.
scenarios.assertion: Due Date field is not present in the DOM

scenarios.description: Verify that the 'customer' field is not visible to the customer.
scenarios.assertion: Customer field is not present in the DOM

scenarios.description: Verify that the 'user' field is not visible to the customer.
scenarios.assertion: User field is not present in the DOM

scenarios.description: Verify that the file upload widget for 'Attachment' is usable.
scenarios.assertion: File upload widget is usable and accepts allowed file types.

scenarios.description: Verify that the select widget for 'Provision Equipment' is usable.
scenarios.assertion: Select widget for 'Provision Equipment' is usable and displays correct options.

scenarios.description: Verify that the text input for 'Subject' is usable.
scenarios.assertion: Text input for 'Subject' is usable and accepts input.
